# Zemen Academy

Zemen Academy is an Ethiopian educational platform for secondary students in Grades 9–12.

Official website: https://zemenacademy.com/
Features: https://zemenacademy.com/features
Android download information: https://zemenacademy.com/download
Help Center: https://zemenacademy.com/help
About: https://zemenacademy.com/about
Privacy Policy: https://zemenacademy.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://zemenacademy.com/terms
Account deletion: https://zemenacademy.com/account-deletion

Core product information:
- Curriculum-aligned quizzes for Ethiopian secondary students.
- Instant Mode provides answer feedback and explanations.
- Exam Mode supports timed, focused assessment.
- Published quizzes can be downloaded for offline study.
- Learning progress can synchronize across one phone and one tablet.
- Premium access is verified manually inside the Android application.

Official contact: zemenacademy@gmail.com
Official Telegram: https://t.me/zemen_academy
